figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT category,SUM(sales) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY category), qualified AS (SELECT category,total FROM totals WHERE total>1000) SELECT * FROM qualified ORDER BY total DESC;
